# 工具版本: ArgyllCMS v2.2.x / v3.x
# 命令: targen -v -d3 -f1024 output

# ========== 启动阶段 ==========
ArgyllCMS targen - Test chart generator
Version 2.2.1

Device type: Emissive display (d3)
Total patches requested: 1024

# ========== 色块生成过程 ==========
# targen 使用自适应优化算法生成色块分布

Generating test chart ...
Created 128 patches (gray axis + primaries)
Created 256 patches (extended gamut)
Created 512 patches (adaptive sampling)
Created 1024 patches (final optimized set)

# ========== 输出文件信息 ==========
Output file: output.ti1
Number of fields: 5
Field names: SAMPLE_ID RGB_R RGB_G RGB_B RGB_XYZ

# ========== ti1 文件预览 ==========
# targen 会在输出中显示 ti1 文件的摘要

NUMBER_OF_SETS 1024
BEGIN_DATA_FORMAT
SAMPLE_ID RGB_R RGB_G RGB_B
END_DATA_FORMAT
BEGIN_DATA
1 A1 0.00000 0.00000 0.00000  # 黑场
2 A2 1.00000 1.00000 1.00000  # 白场
...
1024 A1024 0.51234 0.34567 0.67890
END_DATA

# ========== 预期解析结果 ==========
# 进度检测:
# - "Created X patches" -> 生成进度
# 正则: r'Created\s+(\d+)\s+patches'

# 成功检测:
# - "Output file:" + ".ti1" -> 文件已生成
# - 返回码 = 0
# - 文件存在: output.ti1

# ti1 解析:
# - NUMBER_OF_SETS 行 -> 色块总数
# 正则: r'NUMBER_OF_SETS\s+(\d+)'
